note: Bridges simple_recaptcha and webform via a single Webform handler plugin (id simple_recaptcha). Handler settings: recaptcha_type (v2|v3), v3_score (default 90), v3_error_message, hide_badge_v3. The site/secret keys still come from the parent module's global simple_recaptcha.config. Actually verifying a captcha needs Google keys (external), so all medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL webform-handler config verifiable via drush php:eval on a throwaway webform: introspection reads back the handler's type/score/message; execution adds and configures the handler on a webform. Uses namespaced test webforms (srw_*).

evals.prompt: The simple_recaptcha_webform submodule lets me add reCAPTCHA to a single webform. What is the id of the Webform handler plugin it provides, and where do I add it?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Webform handler plugin with id 'simple_recaptcha' (label reCAPTCHA). Add it on a webform via Settings -> Handlers -> Add handler -> reCAPTCHA.

evals.prompt: What settings can I configure on the simple_recaptcha webform handler for reCAPTCHA v3?
evals.expected_output: On the handler you set recaptcha_type (v2 or v3) and, for v3, v3_score (minimum score, default 90), v3_error_message (shown when the check fails), and hide_badge_v3.

evals.prompt: When using the simple_recaptcha webform handler, where do the actual reCAPTCHA site key and secret key come from?
evals.expected_output: The keys are NOT on the handler; they come from the parent simple_recaptcha module's global config simple_recaptcha.config (site_key/secret_key for v2, site_key_v3/secret_key_v3 for v3). The handler only chooses the version and scoring per webform.

evals.prompt: A webform named srw_known on this site has the simple_recaptcha handler attached. Inspect its live configuration and tell me which reCAPTCHA version and which minimum score the handler is set to.
evals.expected_output: The srw_known webform's simple_recaptcha handler is configured with recaptcha_type v3 and v3_score 88.

evals.prompt: The webform srw_msg has a simple_recaptcha handler with a custom v3 error message. Inspect the live webform configuration and quote that error message.
evals.expected_output: The handler's v3_error_message is 'Bots are not welcome here.'

evals.prompt: The webform srw_task currently has no reCAPTCHA protection. Using the simple_recaptcha_webform submodule, add its reCAPTCHA handler to the srw_task webform and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a webform handler with plugin id simple_recaptcha to the srw_task webform and save, e.g. create it via the webform handler plugin manager and $webform->addWebformHandler($handler); $webform->save(); verify checks the webform has a handler whose plugin id is simple_recaptcha.

evals.prompt: On the webform srw_cfg, add the simple_recaptcha handler configured to use reCAPTCHA v3 with a minimum score of 70, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a simple_recaptcha handler to srw_cfg with settings recaptcha_type = 'v3' and v3_score = 70, then save. verify checks the webform has a simple_recaptcha handler whose settings are v3 / score 70.
